Rwanda rejects blame for eastern DR Congo conflict amid US sanctions
more.description: Rwanda’s foreign minister has rejected claims that Kigali should be held responsible for the conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, insisting the crisis must be resolved by Congolese parties. His remarks came amid fresh US sanctions over alleged Rwandan support for M23 and discussions with European countries on a migrant return centre.
